reviews.review_msg: It's expected to be prepared to write a lot for a course that has a writing credit, however, it's not super well paced and you may find yourself scrambling to write an entire assignment after submitting one just yesterday. Worth the writing credit? Yes. Worth taking for fun? No. I wouldn't take this course with more than 2 other courses.

Do not take this class unless you need to! Too much reading for each week considering it's a 100 levels class. My love for Mythology died down because of this class. Little to no guidance given for the exams.
